q: ------- you require any further assistance with the installation, please contact our technical support team at extension 4512.
zh: 如果您在安裝上還需要任何協助，請撥分機 4512 聯絡我們的技術支援團隊。

q: Had the vendor ------- the defective parts sooner, the assembly line would not have been shut down for three days.
zh: 要是廠商早一點更換那些瑕疵零件，組裝線就不會停工三天了。

q: If the board had approved the merger last year, the company ------- the largest logistics provider in the region today.
zh: 如果董事會去年核准了合併案，這家公司今天就會是該地區最大的物流業者。

q: It is imperative that every employee ------- the updated data-protection training before accessing the client database next month.
zh: 所有員工下個月在存取客戶資料庫之前，都務必完成更新後的資料保護訓練。

q: If the supplier ------- to raise its prices again, we would have no choice but to look for an alternative manufacturer overseas.
zh: 萬一供應商再次漲價，我們將別無選擇，只能另找海外的製造商。

q: ------- the quarterly targets two weeks ahead of schedule, the sales team was rewarded with an extra day of paid leave.
zh: 業務團隊提前兩週達成季度目標，因此獲得額外一天的帶薪假。

q: The contract, ------- by both parties last Tuesday, now goes into effect at the start of the next fiscal quarter.
zh: 這份合約已於上週二由雙方簽署，將自下一個會計季度開始生效。

q: By the time the new CEO takes office in March, the company ------- its restructuring of the overseas divisions.
zh: 等到新任執行長三月上任時，公司將已完成海外部門的重整。

q: When the replacement unit finally arrived at the warehouse, the client ------- the order and requested a full refund.
zh: 等替換品終於送達倉庫時，客戶早已取消訂單並要求全額退款。

q: The number of applicants who have passed the preliminary screening for the engineering positions ------- considerably higher than the hiring committee expected.
zh: 通過工程職缺初步篩選的應徵人數，遠高於招募委員會的預期。

q: Not only ------- the new inventory software reduce processing time, but it also cuts the error rate in half.
zh: 新的庫存軟體不僅縮短處理時間，也讓錯誤率減半。

q: Rarely ------- a first-year analyst been entrusted with a client account as large as the one Ms. Ortiz now manages.
zh: 第一年的分析師很少被託付像 Ortiz 女士目前負責的這麼大的客戶帳戶。

q: No sooner ------- the quarterly results been announced than the company's share price began to climb sharply.
zh: 季度財報一公布，公司股價隨即急速攀升。

q: Before the trade show next week, the marketing director wants to have all the product brochures ------- into Spanish and Portuguese.
zh: 下週商展之前，行銷總監想把所有產品手冊翻譯成西班牙文和葡萄牙文。

q: Several senior engineers objected to ------- to the new facility in Hsinchu without being consulted in advance.
zh: 幾位資深工程師反對在未事先徵詢的情況下被調到新竹的新廠區。

q: The public announcement of the partnership has been postponed ------- final approval from both companies' legal departments.
zh: 合作案的公開宣布已延後，等待雙方公司法務部門的最終核准。

q: ------- the recent slowdown in consumer spending, the retailer expects its holiday sales to exceed last year's record figures.
zh: 儘管近期消費支出放緩，這家零售商仍預期假期銷售額將超越去年的紀錄。

q: ------- any unexpected delays at customs, the replacement components should reach our Kaohsiung plant by Thursday morning.
zh: 除非海關出現意外延誤，替換零件應該會在週四早上前送達我們的高雄廠。

q: Employees who work on national holidays may take a paid day off later in the month ------- overtime pay.
zh: 在國定假日上班的員工，可選擇當月稍後休一天有薪假，以代替加班費。

q: Please direct all inquiries ------- the revised reimbursement policy to Ms. Huang in the accounting department.
zh: 有關修訂後報銷規定的所有問題，請洽會計部的黃小姐。

q: Registration fees are fully refundable if a written cancellation request is received no later than ten business days ------- the start of the seminar.
zh: 若在研討會開始前至少十個工作天收到書面取消申請，報名費可全額退還。

q: All hazardous materials must be stored and labeled ------- the safety regulations issued by the Ministry of Labor.
zh: 所有危險物質都必須依照勞動部發布的安全法規儲存並標示。

q: The museum's gift shop will remain open ------- the entire renovation period, although the main exhibition halls will be closed to visitors.
zh: 博物館禮品店在整個整修期間都會照常營業，不過主要展廳將不對外開放。

q: The success of the product launch was largely attributable ------- the marketing team's aggressive social media campaign.
zh: 產品上市的成功，主要歸功於行銷團隊積極的社群媒體宣傳。

q: Mr. Patel accepted the industry award ------- the entire research team, which spent three years developing the new battery.
zh: Patel 先生代表花了三年研發新電池的整個研究團隊領取這個產業獎項。

q: ------- the shipment is delayed beyond Friday, the customer is entitled to a partial refund under the terms of the contract.
zh: 若貨物延誤超過週五，依合約條款客戶有權獲得部分退款。

q: ------- the factory has upgraded its production equipment, it can now process twice as many orders per shift as it could last year.
zh: 既然工廠已升級生產設備，現在每班能處理的訂單量是去年的兩倍。

q: ------- most of our clients are based in Southeast Asia, it makes sense to open a regional office in Singapore.
zh: 考量到我們大多數客戶都在東南亞，在新加坡設立區域辦公室是合理的。

q: Employees may work remotely up to two days a week ------- their supervisors approve the schedule in advance.
zh: 只要主管事先核准排班，員工每週最多可遠距工作兩天。

q: ------- the board approves the budget at Tuesday's meeting, construction on the new distribution center will begin in early April.
zh: 假設董事會在週二會議通過預算，新物流中心將於四月初動工。

q: Please submit your travel receipts by the 25th of the month; -------, your reimbursement will be delayed until the next pay cycle.
zh: 請在當月 25 日前繳交差旅收據，否則報銷款項將延到下一個發薪週期。

q: The Taipei branch exceeded its sales target by 15 percent, ------- the Tainan branch fell short of its goal for the second consecutive quarter.
zh: 台北分公司超越業績目標 15%，而台南分公司則連續第二季未達標。

q: ------- its strong brand recognition in Europe, the company has struggled to attract customers in the North American market.
zh: 儘管這家公司在歐洲的品牌知名度很高，在北美市場卻一直難以吸引顧客。

q: The planning committee has not yet decided ------- the annual conference will be held in Taichung or moved online this year.
zh: 籌備委員會還沒決定今年的年會要在台中舉辦還是改為線上。

q: The hotel's conference rooms are smaller than we had hoped; -------, they are equipped with excellent audiovisual systems.
zh: 這家飯店的會議室比我們預期的小；即便如此，它們的影音設備非常好。

q: The two regional managers must coordinate closely with ------- to avoid duplicating work during the upcoming system migration.
zh: 兩位區域經理必須密切互相協調，以免在即將進行的系統移轉中重複作業。

q: Our quarterly sales figures were strong, but our main competitor reported results that were considerably stronger than -------.
zh: 我們的季度銷售數字很亮眼，但主要競爭對手公布的成績又比我們的強得多。

q: The prices of the imported components are now nearly twice ------- of the parts we purchase from local suppliers.
zh: 進口零件的價格現在幾乎是我們向本地供應商採購零件價格的兩倍。

q: Ms. Okafor reviewed every clause of the contract -------, as she did not want to rely solely on the legal team's summary.
zh: Okafor 女士親自審閱了合約的每一條條款，因為她不想只依賴法務團隊的摘要。

q: The bonus will go to ------- submits the most accurate sales forecast for the third quarter.
zh: 獎金將頒給提出最準確第三季業績預測的人。

q: Customers who return defective headphones may exchange them for new ------- at any of our retail locations.
zh: 退回瑕疵耳機的顧客，可在我們任何一家門市換成新的。

q: Interns are encouraged to complete the first assignment on ------- own before asking senior staff members for help.
zh: 實習生被鼓勵在請教資深同事之前，先獨力完成第一項作業。

q: The company acquired three smaller software firms last year, ------- have since been merged into its cloud services division.
zh: 公司去年收購了三家較小的軟體公司，這三家後來都已併入其雲端服務部門。

q: The two firms signed a distribution agreement ------- each will sell the other's products in its home market.
zh: 兩家公司簽署經銷協議，依此協議雙方將在各自的本國市場銷售對方的產品。

q: Subscribers may choose either the annual plan or the monthly plan, ------- better suits their budget.
zh: 訂戶可選擇年繳方案或月繳方案，哪一種比較符合預算就選哪一種。

q: The firm interviewed twelve candidates for the auditing position, ------- had sufficient experience with the required accounting software.
zh: 該公司為稽核職缺面試了十二位應徵者，但沒有一位具備所需會計軟體的足夠經驗。

q: It was ------- a successful promotion that management decided to extend it through the end of the month.
zh: 這次促銷非常成功，所以管理階層決定延長到月底。

q: The longer customers are kept on hold by the call center, ------- likely they are to cancel their subscriptions.
zh: 顧客在客服中心等候的時間越長，就越可能取消訂閱。

q: Hardly ------- of the survey respondents said they would recommend the new mobile banking app to their friends.
zh: 幾乎沒有任何受訪者表示會向朋友推薦這款新的行動銀行 App。

q: Applicants ------- portfolios do not include at least three completed projects will not be considered for the senior designer role.
zh: 作品集中未包含至少三件完成作品的應徵者，將不列入資深設計師職位的考慮。
